Title: Azure Cache for Redis Visual Studio Code extension now in preview

Body.Content:
The Visual Studio Code extension for Azure Cache for Redis enables you to access all the caches under your Azure subscriptions and view its data.

With this new integration, you will be able to use Visual Studio Code to view, test, and debug your caches in one streamlined experience. This extension enhances ease of development by eliminating the need to manually track connection and access keys to connect to your caches. Simply authenticate with your Azure account and you will instantly be able to access your Azure Cache for Redis instances. Ultimately, this extension gives you more time to focus on development, debugging, and testing your application.

Learn more about Azure Cache for Redis
